title: Applications of Almost Stationarity I: Quantitative Growth of Injectivity Radius and Stück-Zimmer Theorem
summary: Fraczyk and Gelander proved in \cite{FG} that for any simple Lie group $G$ of high rank and for every non-lattice discrete subgroup $Γ\leq G$, the injectivity radius of points in $G/Γ$ is unbounded, resolving a conjecture of Margulis. In this work we obtain an explicit lower bound on the growth rate of the maximal injectivity radius of points taken from growing balls in $G/Γ$. More explicitly, we prove that for any $R>0$, one can embed a ball of radius $c\log^{(4)}R$ in $G/Γ$ centered at some point $[g]\in G/Γ$ where $g$ is taken from $G_R$ and for some constant $c=c(G,Γ)$.
